posts.text:
The “FISA goes dark Friday” panic is overblown. Existing surveillance runs through March 2027 and most foreign intel never needed FISA 702 anyway. The real story: oversight bodies have been gutted while the spying continues. We're not going blind, warns Cato’s @PGEddington. We're going unaccountable.
